translated_title: Sheinbaum Criticized the Court for Restoring Privileges Such as Medical Expenses Insurance
original_title: Sheinbaum criticó a la Corte por restituir privilegios, como el seguro de gastos médicos
author: Nancy Flores
meta_description: President Sheinbaum rebuked six Supreme Court justices for voting to restore taxpayer-funded major medical insurance for judicial staff, invoking Benito Juárez and republican austerity: “No to privileges.”
